2:18.text: Then the LORD God said, "It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper fit for him."
2:18.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

11:4.text: Then they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, and a tower with its top in the heavens, and let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth."
11:4.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

1:27.text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.
